name: Pickpackify By Brainbean
author: brainbean

sections.description:
Brainbean Pick and Pack (Pickpackify) transforms your WooCommerce store into a professional order fulfillment system. Your team can pick and pack orders using visual pipelines directly from any device, eliminating fulfillment errors, speeding up processing times, and ditching paper packing slips for good.
Native to WooCommerce, supports High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS), and works seamlessly on any device — phone, tablet, or desktop.

Pickpackify is also a powerful barcode scanning tool: scan items using a USB scanner or your device’s camera to guarantee 100% packing accuracy, action orders across drag-and-drop pipelines, and track processing efficiency in real time.

What’s in the free version

  • Order management: pick, pack, and finalize orders, mark them as completed, and print packing slips
  • Visual pipelines: move orders across different fulfillment stages
  • USB Barcode scanning: scan items using a standard USB scanner to guarantee 100% packing accuracy
  • Sort by warehouse locations: sort and filter order items by their specific warehouse location
  • Sort by category: easily filter items based on their product category
  • Activity logs: track all order and packing actions
  • Out of stock management: efficiently manage stock status for items

Available with the Pro version

Pickpackify Pro extends the free plugin with all free functionalities plus:

  • Mobile Camera Scanner: use your mobile phone or tablet’s camera to scan products on the go, automatically updating live
  • Batch picking and packing: group multiple orders or items to pick and pack them efficiently at once
  • Premium support: raise support tickets directly for priority assistance
  • Manage licenses: easily manage your plugin license

The Pro version does not require this free plugin to be installed. Upgrade to Pro today at: http://pickpackify.com/

External Services

This plugin can optionally connect to an external service to register your free setup and receive product updates, security notices, and relevant newsletters.

  • Service URL: https://pickpackify.com/wp-json/pickpackify/v1/free-register
  • Data transmitted: Email address, site domain, site URL, and plugin version.
  • Consent: This connection is strictly optional and requires your explicit checkbox consent during setup. If skipped, no network requests are sent and no data is shared.
  • Privacy Policy: https://pickpackify.com/privacy-policy/
  • Terms of Use: https://pickpackify.com/terms/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/brainbean-pick-and-pack-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Brainbean Pick and Pack in your left-hand admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with custom database tables (HPOS)?

Yes! Brainbean Pick and Pack is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and active to use Brainbean Pick and Pack.

Is barcode scanning supported?

Yes! You can use any standard USB or Bluetooth barcode scanner via the text input box.
